case_name: Contradictory Evidence — T1 vs T3 Conflicts
case_description: Regional bank assessed in HYBRID mode with intentional contradictions between evidence tiers. Tests how assessment skill resolves conflicts: T1 vs T3, T2 vs T5, timing conflicts. Verifies contradiction_log completion and resolution rationale documentation.

evidence_t1.fact: Mobile logins: 45% of active users, trailing 12 months

evidence_t3.source: J.D. Power Digital Banking Benchmarking Study
evidence_t3.fact: Bank's mobile adoption: 38% of customer base

contradictions_test_cases.contradiction_nature: Call Report shows 45%; J.D. Power shows 38%. 7-point discrepancy. Likely due to: (1) different denominators (active users vs. total customers), (2) timing (3mo vs. 12mo ago), (3) methodology (logins vs. adoption)
contradictions_test_cases.resolution_rule: T1 source (Call Report) takes precedence over T3 (analyst report). Call Report is audited, regulatory-mandated. Accept 45% as correct.

expected_resolution.reasoning: T1 regulatory source trumps T3 analyst estimate
expected_resolution.score_implication: Score P2C3 onboarding using 45% metric, not 38%

contradictions_test_cases.conflict_type: T2 vs T5 — Claim Credibility Mismatch

evidence_t2.fact: Bank states: 'Data governance framework in place; board oversight established'

evidence_t5.fact: Bank claims: 'Industry-leading data analytics and AI-powered insights'

evidence_internal.source: Internal Risk Management Audit (Provided by Bank)
evidence_internal.fact: Data governance found to have 'significant gaps'; only 60% of data elements classified; no automated discovery tool

contradictions_test_cases.contradiction_nature: 10-K (T2) claims governance 'in place'; website (T5) makes aggressive AI claims; internal audit (T4) documents 'significant gaps'. Three conflicting signals.
contradictions_test_cases.resolution_rule: Precedence: T2 10-K > T4 internal > T5 website. 10-K is audited and regulatory filing; internal audit corroborates deficiencies; website is marketing.

expected_resolution.winning_fact: Data governance framework documented but with significant gaps (per 10-K claim corroborated by internal audit)
expected_resolution.reasoning: T2 is authoritative; T4 internal audit validates the limits of the framework
expected_resolution.score_implication: P4C1 Data Governance scores M2–M3 (framework exists but incomplete), not M4–M5 (internal audit disputes marketing claims)

evidence_older.fact: Bank had consent order issued 2015; current status: TERMINATED (2019)

evidence_newer.fact: Bank states: 'Resolved compliance matter from prior years; no outstanding regulatory actions'

evidence_conflicting.fact: Article from 6 months ago: 'Bank facing scrutiny over AML procedures; regulators investigating'

contradictions_test_cases.contradiction_nature: T1 source (CFPB DB) shows old issue terminated. T2 (bank's own statement) says no outstanding actions. T3 (news) suggests recent scrutiny. Which is current state?
contradictions_test_cases.resolution_rule: Temporal hierarchy: Most recent credible source wins. T1 CFPB DB (updated in real-time, authoritative) is most reliable. If CFPB shows terminated, that's final status. News article (T3) may refer to prior matter or initial investigation.

expected_resolution.winning_fact: Consent order terminated (2019); currently no CFPB enforcement action
expected_resolution.reasoning: T1 regulatory source is authoritative on enforcement status; news article likely refers to same historical matter
expected_resolution.score_implication: Cap P3C3 Compliance at 3.5 (terminated action <24mo = S2 severity cap applies); do not score as if currently under enforcement (would be S3, cap 1.5)

contradictions_test_cases.conflict_type: T3 vs T4 — Pilot vs Production Status

evidence_t3.fact: Bank noted as 'growing vendor user' in Gartner ecosystem; implementing APIs for third-party integrations

evidence_t4.fact: API initiative: PILOT PHASE (launched Q3 2023); production rollout planned Q3 2024; currently 3 pilot APIs (payment processor, data aggregator, loan origination partner)

contradictions_test_cases.contradiction_nature: Gartner (T3) implies production-level API ecosystem; internal docs (T4) reveal only pilot status with 3 APIs. Analyst view is overstated relative to reality.
contradictions_test_cases.resolution_rule: For project status, internal documentation (T4) is more reliable than analyst commentary (T3). Pilot status is materially different from production deployment.

expected_resolution.winning_fact: APIs in PILOT: 3 live integrations; production rollout planned Q3 2024
expected_resolution.reasoning: Internal roadmap is authoritative for implementation status; analyst report reflects intended direction but overstates current state
expected_resolution.score_implication: P4C3 Technology Architecture: Score M2–M3 for current state (pilot), not M4 (production). Trend potential to M4 if pilot succeeds, but current evidence supports M3.

expected_outcomes.rationale: Regional bank with mature operations but conflicting signals on digital maturity. T1/T2 evidence base is solid (regulatory/official disclosure tier). Contradictions mostly resolve in favor of 'more mature but not fully production-ready' interpretation. Expected score: mid-M3 range.

expected_pillar_scores.P1_rationale: Board governance documented in 10-K; stable regulatory status supports governance maturity M3–M4
expected_pillar_scores.P2_rationale: Mobile adoption at 45% (above median); API pilot indicates innovation consideration; expect M3
expected_pillar_scores.P3_rationale: Compliance: terminated enforcement (not current issue); no cap applies. Operational maturity mid-M3.
expected_pillar_scores.P4_rationale: Data governance documented but gapped (not AI-powered as claimed); APIs in pilot. Lower M3 / upper M2.

CONTR-002.resolved_fact: Data governance framework with significant gaps (T2 + T4 corroboration)
CONTR-002.resolution_method: Discount T5 marketing claims; T2 + T4 alignment provides credible picture

CONTR-003.resolution_method: T1 regulatory DB authoritative; news article context acceptable

CONTR-004.resolved_fact: APIs in pilot (3 live); production rollout Q3 2024
CONTR-004.resolution_method: T4 internal docs > T3 analyst commentary for implementation status

test_tolerances.contradiction_resolution_accuracy: All 4 contradictions must be resolved per expected_resolutions above; ≥80% accuracy required

governance_audit_expectations.contradiction_log_completeness: All 4 contradictions must be documented in contradiction_log with: Fact_A (evidence ID E-201), Fact_B (evidence ID E-202), Contradiction_Type, Resolution rule applied, Winning Fact, Rationale
governance_audit_expectations.score_justification: Rationales for P2C3, P4C1, P3C3, P4C3 must cite specific contradiction resolution: 'Resolved T1 vs T3 conflict on mobile adoption by accepting T1 regulatory data (45%)'
governance_audit_expectations.cr01_check: CR-01 Critic findings addressed — If critic flagged 'marketing claims unsupported' on data governance, evidence should be present documenting this concern was anticipated

regression_test_gate.test_case_purpose: Verify assessment skill handles contradictory evidence correctly: (1) Applies precedence rules (T1>T3>T5), (2) Resolves timing conflicts, (3) Documents contradictions with clear winning facts, (4) Derives scores from resolved facts, not conflicting claims
pass_criteria: All 4 contradictions documented in contradiction_log with resolution rules cited
Rationales for affected capabilities (P2C3, P4C1, P3C3, P4C3) mention contradiction resolution
Final scores align with RESOLVED facts (not discarded conflicting claims)
No scores inflated by unresolved marketing claims (P4C1 not M4+ on AI claim; P4C3 not M4 on production APIs)
